column3: “Disarm kings” interprets loosening the loins of kings.
“For battle” adds a purpose to the equipment.
Turns the request to ask into a reproachful question and joins the coming things to the sons.
Adds Cyrus as the subject’s name; “rebuild” specifies building.
“In a wasteland” interprets the word for emptiness.
“Cannot save” adds inability to the statement that the god does not save.
Adds “your case” as the object brought forward.
Omits “I have” and joins those who rage directly to those coming.
